title: Repair, Wear, Maintenance & Emergency Engineering
objective: Implement profile-driven repair-class orchestration, wear/reliability/service-state interpretation, maintenance operations, and emergency patch/bypass/substitute/jury-rig workflows that emit typed owner-operation requests without inventing universal repair quality, wear, service interval, jury-rig penalty, emergency bonus, permission bypass or canonical owner mutation.
acceptance: Repair class and permitted outcomes come from owner definitions rather than universal quality bands.
Wear, reliability and service intervals remain profile-driven; absent values remain unresolved.
Maintenance due/overdue state derives only from declared owner/profile evidence and cannot invent wall-clock or service rules.
Emergency patch, bypass, substitute and jury-rig effects exist only when governed definitions explicitly provide them.
Emergency workflows cannot bypass permission, compatibility, owner-version, prerequisite or owner-operation validation.
Recovered/substitute parts preserve LSS/D17 provenance and compatibility evidence rather than becoming anonymous MERA inventory.
MIB-12 retains repair/refurbishment/remanufacture/fabrication transaction authority; MERA emits typed requests only.
Partial owner-operation success is represented by actual receipts and never guessed as universal success/failure.
Blocking repair/maintenance/emergency workflows remain semantic/nonvisual and provider-off.
boundaries: LSS retains recovered-part and donor provenance/recoverability authority.
APW/D26 and DPL/Profession retain project/time/worker capability.
MERA has no universal reliability, wear, repair-quality, service interval, jury-rig penalty or emergency-bonus formula.
MERA-10+ dependency/network/failure and domain adapter work remains unauthorized.
MBES remains blocked until MERA completes at MERA-24.
next_action: On the next owner Continue, start only MERA-07. Preload MERA-01/03/05/06, MRCS repair/wear/service definitions, MIB-12 transaction seams, LSS/D17 provenance, compatibility/owner-version checks, APW/D26 and DPL/Profession prerequisite bindings, and Packet-07 recovery semantics.
